name: WARNING: Raw Sugar Snap Peas & Fibrous Snow Pea Pods
whyItWorks: Raw snap peas and whole pea pods contain tough lateral strings and leathery outer parchment. Highly resistant to breakdown, posing significant mechanical risk across strictures and ileostomies.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid raw pea pods from party trays or salads. If eating peas, choose tender shelled sweet green peas simmered soft or pureed.
